appRequirements.boot: ShaderRegistry fetches shaders/index.json, then the app requirements, then only the digest-addressed source and receipt blobs named by those requirements. Material variant indexes are fetched only on a dynamic variant miss.

appDelta.merge: Published ESM uses relative imports so module workers do not need a document import map. App-owned compact v2 delta is optional and never merged onto a 25MB shared compact catalog. Vite --base may rewrite only app-local URLs.
